verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents a Files API with create/read/edit/move/delete operations over REST, plus SDKs (JS, Python, etc.) and webhooks, and the JS SDK GitHub example demonstrates listing folder contents via API calls (filesListFolder). This covers upload/download/list/move/delete as documented endpoints beyond the desktop client. Missing for 10: explicit upload/download code samples in evidence and independent third-party corroboration of full CRUD REST endpoint behavior beyond official docs.
